scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. Five live Lv 8 Deity Korea Online turns on the luxury slot where the live bridge held its swap (luxury_swap_hold:no_spare or :no_fit) with a city short of Amenities: civvis-20261104T213449Z t82 and t88, 20261104T215303Z t82, 20261104T220040Z-cont1 t94, 20261104T221505Z t64, each the run's events.jsonl cut at the end of the turn and queried with the run's own requested genome on a frozen ci-profile civvis_orders built from the branch. Every off arm reproduces the live hold (no luxury ask). Three on arms instead ask a partner at peace for a luxury we lack paying in strategics: LUXURY_ANY;RESOURCE_NITER=4 (Gold to 215), RESOURCE_NITER=3 (to 185), RESOURCE_HORSES=2 (to 79); the other two hold luxury_strategic_hold:no_strategic (the stockpile is reserved for our units and upgrades).
